principle: No production switch is inferred from a green CI run. Every external dependency must be verified explicitly.

gates.requirement: Full build, content, governance, HTML and browser QA green on release candidate.
HIPStudio is the approved master brand and hipstudio.hu the target master domain.
No public package pricing or automatic price calculator is exposed.
Client, result, testimonial and heritage claims are evidence-gated.
Unsupported direct-provider and regulated-responsibility wording remains blocked until service-level evidence is approved.
Approve controller identity, privacy notice, form processing basis, retention and subprocessors before live form submission.
Verify browser POST to Apps Script, Sheet append, internal notifications, customer confirmation and info@ Send-As/Reply-To in the live environment.
Obtain authoritative HelloÜzlet and Flúgos URL exports/crawls; classify every source URL before activating redirects.
Select production hosting and verify TLS, cache policy, security headers, canonical host, 404/410 behavior and real 301 rules.
Point hipstudio.hu only after staging verification and rollback plan.
Remove review noindex, publish production sitemap and verify canonical/redirect behavior only after cutover.

activationRule: Production may be activated only when every blocked_* gate is resolved and documented. No shortcuts; Google is patient, broken redirects are less so.
